SPEC_1.name: The Snoop
SPEC_1.description: Immediate: Look at an opponents hand of Action Cards. Steal 1 card of your choice and add it to your hand. Effect: That opponent acquires 1 replacement card from the facedown action deck.

SPEC_2.description: Immediate: Choose an opponent; they must return 1 recruited Agent from their active staff back to the open market. Effect: The bank pays that opponent Profit Tokens equal to that Agent's Profit.

SPEC_3.name: The Lobbyist
SPEC_3.description: Immediate: Place BLOCKED Token on any Hub on the board.  Effect: That Hub is completely locked. No other player may place a meeple there for the remainder of the round (even if open action slots remain).

SPEC_4.name: The Inside Source
SPEC_4.description: Immediate: Draw the top 5 Agents. You may immediately recruit up to two (2) of them to your brokerage for free. Cleanup: Return all remaining cards to the bottom of the deck.

SPEC_5.description: Passive (Permanent): Place this card next to your player board. For the rest of the game, increase your maximum hand size by +2 and your maximum Office Desk Agent capacity by +1.

SPEC_6.name: The Clean Slate
SPEC_6.description: Immediate: Choose up to 3 cards from your hand or discard pile and permanently Trash (Cull) them from the game.  Effect: Draw 1 replacement card from your deck for each card trashed this way.

SPEC_7.name: The Automation Engineer
SPEC_7.description: Immediate: Place a personal cube here to permanently copy one main board Action Space.  Passive (Permanent): Once per round, trigger this action without a Meeple. Standard resource and Profit Token fees still apply.

SPEC_8.name: The Venture Capitalist
SPEC_8.description: Passive (Permanent): Place this card next to your board. For the rest of the game, whenever you advance a track cube onto any odd number (3, 5, 7, 9), immediately gain $3 Profit Tokens from the bank.

SPEC_9.name: The Executive Overdrive
SPEC_9.description: Immediate: Place the Specialty Meeple on any occupied Action Space (even if full).  Effect: Trigger that space's action twice back-to-back. If the action requires an operational cost (like Trashing a card), trigger the second action without paying that cost.

SPEC_10.name: The Corporate Merger
SPEC_10.description: Immediate: Place the Specialty Meeple bridging two of your track cubes together.  Passive (Round Only): For the rest of this round, whenever you advance one of those tracks, the other track automatically advances +1 space for free.

SPEC_11.name: The Ghost in the Machine
SPEC_11.description: Immediate: Place the Specialty Meeple on an opponent's player board.  Passive (Round Only): For the rest of this round, you copy and use that opponent's unlocked Level 5 Tech Tree passive ability as if it were your own.

SPEC_12.name: The Shell Company
SPEC_12.description: Immediate: Draw 5 Agents face-down. Recruit one (1) immediately for free. Passive (Round Only): You may recruit a second Agent from this stash using normal brokerage values. Discard the rest at round end.

SPEC_13.name: The Hostile Takeover
SPEC_13.description: Immediate: Place the Specialty Meeple on the Turn Track next to your Turn Meeple.  Effect: Next round, you automatically become the 1st player and immediately take two (2) turns back-to-back before any other player can place a meeple.
